query.name: command-project-list
query.sql: SELECT project.id AS id, project.name AS name, project.status AS status, COUNT(branch.id) AS branch_count, (SELECT COUNT(build.id) FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.project_id = project.id) AS build_count FROM porion_project AS project LEFT JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON project.id = branch.project_id GROUP BY project.id
query.sql-count: SELECT count(project.id) FROM porion_project AS project
